notes: A reply INTERRUPTED mid-stream on Claude Code 2.1.251, re-baked for PUPPET-246. The interrupt block reads exactly "⎿  Interrupted · What should Claude do instead?" — U+23BF, ASCII space, U+00A0, then the text — unchanged from the 2.1.185 recording this replaces, so claudecode.interruptMarker did NOT move at 2.1.251; what moved is the KEY. Esc (0x1b) interrupts and paints that block; Ctrl-C (0x03), which the recorder wrote unconditionally before this ticket, stops the turn, paints nothing and restores the prompt into the composer — a clear, not an interrupt. The script therefore asks for "interrupt_key": "esc", and waits for the reply to actually start streaming (the ⏺ bullet) before pressing it: an Esc that lands before the first token cancels the request and is likewise painted as nothing. Recorded via `make rebake-corpus HARNESS=claude SCENARIO=interrupted-mid-reply`. 2.1.251 runs its TUI on the alternate screen, so the tail of bytes.raw is the alt-screen exit followed by the "claude --resume" epilogue: replay incrementally and read the last frame carrying the harness footer (lastLiveFrame), as production does.
